question: Blended Latent Diffusion은 이미지의 어느 영역을 편집하나?

papers.title: Blended Latent Diffusion
papers.abstract: We present an accelerated solution to the task of local text-driven editing of generic images, where the desired edits are confined to a user-provided mask. Our solution leverages a recent text-to-image Latent Diffusion Model (LDM), which speeds up diffusion by operating in a lower-dimensional latent space.

papers.title: Q-Diffusion: Quantizing Diffusion Models
papers.abstract: Our method quantizes full-precision diffusion models into 4-bit in a training-free manner, and can run stable diffusion in 4-bit weights with high generation quality for the first time.

question: Smooth Diffusion 학습에는 GPU가 몇 대 사용되었나?

papers.title: Smooth Diffusion
papers.abstract: We propose Smooth Diffusion, a new category of diffusion models that can be simultaneously high-performing and smooth. We introduce Step-wise Variation Regularization and devise an interpolation standard deviation (ISTD) metric to assess latent space smoothness.
